title: Chapter 220: Fold-Ear Cat Tribe Fold-Ear City
content:
Chapter 220: Fold-Ear Cat Tribe Fold-Ear City

The reputation of the Zerg has not been publicized yet, and it is worthless. If the Silkworm Knights do not have some strength, they may not be able to move forward, not to mention the need to promote the Silkworm Nine Transformations.

Now there are four-star knights in the Silkworm Knights' team of 100 people. All of them are strong, and they have some confidence to walk in the free land.

What is the outside world like? This is the first time the Zerg have come into contact with it.

Hundreds of Silkworm Knights rushed to the northwest quickly. The strength of the Zerg war horses has been improved, and their speed has increased.

The Silkworm Knights did not encounter any intelligent creatures along the way. They can deal with some ordinary dangers calmly.

After running for nearly an hour, a huge city finally appeared in front of them.

The scale of this city is much larger than all the cities in the Zerg territory. From a distance, people come and go, and it is busy.

Outside the city are endless fields and large-scale mines, with a large number of people working and well-equipped troops patrolling outside the city.

There are also many buildings in some areas outside the city, indicating that the lord's protection range of this city is very large.

The Silkworm Knight stood on a high place and looked at it, and then rushed to the city.

The cities in the Free Land are basically open and free cities, allowing people to travel freely. Even those exclusive cities of various races and forces will provide convenience for people to travel.

The Silkworm Knight approached the city and saw the three big characters of Folding Ear City on the tall city gate.

The black armor and red cloak designed by Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects for the Silkworm Knight are very eye-catching. Coupled with the powerful Zerg warhorse and the extraordinary momentum of the Silkworm Knight, the Silkworm Knight has become the focus along the way.

"Where did the knight come from? So majestic!"

"Tsk tsk! This set of equipment is really eye-catching!"

"Tiancan? What a cute little bug!"

"These mounts are so perfect!"

"A team of strong men, I wonder what will happen!"

"..."

Outside the city, many people saw the various people of Tiancan Knight, and they were talking about it.

This is outside the influence of the Zerg, and in a completely unfamiliar place. Wu Qing did not let the Tiancan Knight act arbitrarily, but prepared to let the Tiancan Knight visit the official forces here first.

Naga and Gong Zhe of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce only gave a very simple introduction to the Southern Free Land, and more information still had to be collected by the Zerg themselves.

Wu Qing had no idea what this Folded Ear City was like.

The Tiancan Knight came to the city gate and lined up with the people entering the city to be inspected.

This should be considered the front line of the faction war, and the Free Land is a mixed bag, so it is understandable to inspect people entering the city.

This kind of inspection is very fast, and many soldiers in charge of inspection just took a look and let them go.

It didn't take long before it was the turn of the Silkworm Knights. Following the local customs, the Silkworm Knights all dismounted and led their horses.

The excellent equipment and the team of 100 Silkworm Knights aroused the vigilance of the inspecting soldiers.

"Who are you? Where are you from? Why are you in the city?"

The soldiers in charge of the inspection rarely asked three questions in a row.

"We are the Silkworm Knights of the Zerg, from the Zerg territory, traveling in the free land, and inheriting the Zerg skills!"

"This time, in addition to looking around and looking for some predestined people, we also want to see if we can visit the person in charge of the city!"

"My Zerg territory is nearby, we are friendly neighbors, and we need to increase some understanding!"

The captain of the four-star Silkworm Knights replied.

"Zerg? The territory is nearby?"

The soldiers in charge of the inspection were obviously a little unconvinced.

These words attracted more attention to the already eye-catching Silkworm Knights.

"Zerg? Haven't you heard of this race? They look like humans!"

"Is the territory nearby? Isn't this the closest to the Endless Mountains?"

"Could it be the forbidden land in the legend?"

"..."

The captain of the Silkworm Knights spoke loudly, and everyone nearby heard it, and many people were whispering.

"Zerg is a large tribe that has recently entered the world, and the place of entry is the forbidden land where the Naga and Tengu tribes were originally located!"

"Zerg has exchanged the territory of the forbidden land with the two large tribes of Naga and Tengu. The forbidden land to the southeast of this place is the first territory of the Zerg after entering the world!"

"We, the Silkworm Knights, are walking outside, one is to announce the official entry of the Zerg, and the other is to pass on the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Changes, a technique specially customized by the Zerg masters, to the ordinary people, to do our part to change the current situation!"

The Silkworm Knights explained loudly.

"A newly entered clan? They dare to call themselves a clan. This Zerg is not simple!"

"It turned out to be a forbidden land! I didn't expect it to be the territory of the Zerg now!"

"A clan appeared around us. I don't know what impact it will have on the current situation!"

"Nine Transformations of the Silkworm? Customized by a powerful person? For ordinary people? I don't know what kind of skills it is!"

"The name of the Silkworm Knight is printed on the armor. With the Nine Transformations of the Silkworm, this lovely silkworm is a great thing?"

"..."

The people in the Southern Free Land are not as knowledgeable as those in the forbidden land. They heard a lot of information from the words of the captain of the Silkworm Knight.

The soldiers in charge of the inspection in Zheer City became much better after listening to the explanation of the captain of the Silkworm Knights.

This world still respects the races that have just entered the world. No matter how strong they are, they will contribute their strength when they enter this world, not to mention that this is a race that dares to call itself a great race.

"So it's a race that has just entered the world! You can enter the city!"

"If you want to visit the adults in the city, please go to the city hall and someone will receive you!"

The soldiers let them go and specifically told them how to visit the person in charge of the city.

The inspection at the city gate is just to eliminate very obvious dangers, and the soldiers generally don't make things difficult.

The real potential dangers are not something that the soldiers at the city gate can check out, and it is not their responsibility.

"Thank you very much!"

The captain of the Silkworm Knights thanked him and led a hundred Silkworm Knights into the city.

After passing the city gate, they got on their horses and rode forward on the main street, leaving only countless discussions at the city gate.

The Silkworm Knight collected information along the way and walked straight to the city hall.

The people's livelihood in this city is somewhat similar to the normal city that Wu Qing knows, except that the people in the city are of various races, not a single human race.

Most of these people are still ordinary people, but the proportion of people with star strength has increased significantly, and people with extraordinary momentum can often be seen.

After this period of research and comparison, Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects have also gained a certain understanding of the external manifestation of the strength of this world. It is mainly judged by the special momentum brought by the invisible luck. People with strong momentum have strong strength.

Continue to contact more strong people, and this way of distinguishing strength will be more perfect and accurate.

The city is very large, and the Silkworm Knight spent a long time asking for directions before finding the city hall.

The city hall is a very tall and imposing building complex, guarded by powerful soldiers, and few people go in and out.

The arrival of the Silkworm Knight attracted the attention of the guards.

After reporting his identity again and stating his purpose, the guards reported it. Not long after, a person with some cat characteristics came out to greet him.

"The Scottish Fold Cat Tribe City Hall welcomes the visit of the Zerg Clan's envoys!"

The visitor was very enthusiastic and welcomed the Silkworm Knight into the city hall.

After some friendly communication, the two sides had a certain understanding of each other.

This Scottish Fold City is the tribe city of the Scottish Fold Cat Tribe, one of the branches of the cat tribe.

The obvious feature of the Scottish Fold Cat is that the cat ears on the human head are bent, which is different from other cat tribes. They form a small tribe of their own.

In this world, if there are many branches within the tribe, many branches will form their own tribe.

Except for some powerful tribes with very strong cohesion, most of the tribes have poor cohesion. Some tribes have greater conflicts within the tribe than conflicts outside the tribe.

Even if it is a large tribe, there are many branches and factions within it.

This is the nature of intelligent creatures. Even if there is a powerful external enemy like the evil god camp, there are still various struggles within.

Perhaps since the birth of wisdom, this struggle has never stopped.

This is the case with the Scottish Fold Cat Tribe. They are far away from the cat tribe and built such a city with the power of the whole tribe in this remote place in the southern free land.

This city named after the tribe is where all the wealth of the Scottish Fold Cats is.

Although it was not stated explicitly, Wu Qing knew that the Scottish Fold Cats would have a hard time after learning this information.

The front line of the camp war was not far ahead. If the local camp continued to lose, they would have to give up this city.

Losing this city, the difficulty of starting over again can be imagined.

It is very likely that the Scottish Fold Cats will never recover and become the weakest wandering race.

After the Scottish Fold Cats learned some news about the Zerg, higher-level personnel came out to meet with the captain of the Silkworm Knight, and the two sides initially confirmed the friendly relationship between the two tribes.

The Scottish Fold Cats expressed support for the mission of the Silkworm Knight and looked forward to further strengthening cooperation with the Zerg.

The identity of the Zerg as a large tribe is self-proclaimed. Although they are confident, they are still unreliable now. The Scottish Fold Cats, a race that can survive alone here, will not blindly believe in a race like the Zerg that suddenly appeared.

How the relationship between the two tribes will develop in the future still depends on the strength and reputation of the Zerg.

Wu Qing had no idea about a small race like the Scottish Fold Cat. He just needed a point of entry to understand the scale and intensity of the camp war, as well as various intelligence that the Zerg didn't know.

Unclear intelligence was the main reason why the Zerg didn't dare to take action.

Otherwise, Wu Qing would have sent troops to attack the demon tribe's sphere of influence in the northeast.

The Sky Silkworm Knight gained the support of the Scottish Fold Cat tribe. In addition to collecting information from all parties, he began to promote the Sky Silkworm Nine Transformations in the Scottish Fold City.

When the magic of the Zerg Sky Silkworm Nine Transformations was confirmed, it immediately triggered a wave of enthusiasm in the Scottish Fold City.
